# Appendix

A. Complete File Inventory
The project codebase is organized as follows:
- src/config.py: Centralized configuration parameters
- src/logger.py: Standardized Python logging setup
- src/exceptions.py: Custom pipeline exceptions
- src/preprocessing_data/pre_processing.py: Ingestion preprocessing
- src/feature_engineering/build_features.py: Embedding representations
- src/models/retriever.py: Hybrid search and reranking
- src/models/predict_model.py: Generation models
- src/models/prompts.py: Structured prompts
- src/agents/query_router.py: Pre-retrieval routing agent
- src/agents/query_rewriter.py: Chat-history rewrite agent
- src/db/mongo_data_layer.py: MongoDB asynchronous motor connector
- src/pipelines/ingestion.py: Indexing orchestration
- src/pipelines/query.py: Runtime query execution
- src/evaluation/improved_ragas_eval.py: Post-generation RAGAS evaluations
- synthetic_data_generator.py: Document clustering and QA pair generator
- src/visualization/app.py: UI visualization launcher

B. Environment Variables Quick Reference
The system requires the following environment variables set in a local .env file:
- PINECONE_API_KEY: Authentication key for Pinecone DB.
- GROQ_API_KEY: Authentication key for Groq LLMs.
- GOOGLE_API_KEY: Authentication key for Gemini evaluation judge.
- MONGO_URI: URI for MongoDB database (defaults to mongodb://localhost:27017).

C. CLI Command Cheat Sheet
The following commands drive the main system tasks:
- Indexing Pipeline: python src/main.py --ingest
- Single Query Run: python src/main.py --query "Question text"
- Evaluate exact match: python src/main.py --evaluate --num 20
- Run RAGAS Judge: python src/evaluation/improved_ragas_eval.py --samples 20
- Launch Web Interface: python src/main.py --app
- Generate Synthetic QA: python synthetic_data_generator.py --dataset hotpotqa --top-clusters 50
